newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PENPIX OF VICENZA SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PENPIX OF VICENZA SQUAD.

text.p: Pen pictures of the Vicenza players most likely to appear in Saturday's serie A clash with Juventus at the Delle Alpi stadium in Turin.

Luca Mondini, goalkeeper, 27. In his second season at Vicenza after joining from Inter. Has been alternating recently with Pierluigi Brivio, who helped club reach the Italian Cup final on Tuesday against Bologna.

Luigi Sartor, defender, 22. Made his serie A debut with Juventus as a 17-year-old in December 1992, his only top flight league game for the club, before moving to Reggiana for a season and then to Vicenza in 1994. The only Vicenza player with European experience, having played one UEFA Cup match as a 76th minute substitute with Juventus against Cyprus team Anorthosis Famagusta in Larnaca in late 1992. Fighting ankle injury.
Davide Belotti, defender, 24. First signed as a youth with Inter before three seasons in third division.
Giovanni Lopez, defender, 29. Roman-born player who has been with Vicenza since they were in serie C1 and has rarely missed a league match since, recently acting as captain.
Gilberto d'Ignazio, defender, 28. Another veteran from the serie C1 days, joining from Taranto in 1992.
Gustavo Mendez, defender, 26. Uruguayan, joining at the same time as team mate Marcelo Otero, from Nacional Montevideo where he had hitherto spent his entire career.
Giampiero Maini, midfielder, 25. Joined Vicenza from Roma last season.

Domenico Di Carlo, midfielder, 32. Wins in the loyalty stakes as oldest man in team. Has been at Vicenza since 1990, when he left serie C side Palermo, and last weekend played his 200th league game for the club. Last season was his first in serie A after 17 years playing in the second and third divisions. Says he wants to carry on until the year 2000.
Massimo Beghetto, midfielder, 28. Utility player in his first season in serie A after 12 years in lower divisions. Helped Perugia to the top flight last season. Scored last weekend against Piacenza.

Fabio Viviani, midfielder, 30. Made his serie A debut against Juventus while with Como in 1987. Played six league games from AC Milan in 1988 before being discarded. Joined Vicenza in serie C in 1992 and one of the core of old timers who has fought through successive promotions to return to serie A. Overlaps with Mendez and often loses out to the Uruguayan.

Marcelo Otero, striker, 25. Uruguayan who joined Vicenza from Penarol in 1995 and has provided the leap in quality needed to keep the club in serie A. Scored 12 goals last season and has scored 12 so far this season, arousing interest from other clubs. Newspapers have recently begun linking him with a move to Juventus, where Uruguayan Paolo Montero also plays.

Roberto Murgita, striker, 28. Useful Genoese who was disqualified for Tuesday's Cup semifinal against Bologna after scoring only goal of first leg. Should be back on Saturday. Scored 10 goals in league last season, five this season.

Giovanni Cornacchini, striker, 31. After eight years in third division, made his serie A debut against Juventus for AC Milan in 1991. Then returned to lower reaches for five years before helping Bologna to serie A last season. Scored the goal against his old club on Tuesday that put Vicenza in Italian Cup final for first time in their 95-year history.
